purpose: Default DENY. Any observation probe must be declared, A/A' calibrated, and non-perturbing.
enforcement: An undeclared probe triggers INVALID_PROBE → G0 FAIL.
A probe that mutates reference DOM/Style triggers harnessDomMutations != 0 → G0 FAIL.
A probe whose A/A' delta exceeds envelope(A/A) → INVALID_PROBE, G0 FAIL.
notes: F0 may add observation-only probes (read APIs) under A/A' gating.
Reference gelée is never instrumented. App probes must be declared.
